completeness_note: All category-card links under the selected root and all discovered pagination links/Livewire page buttons were followed; product URLs canonically deduplicated; grouped raw-material listings retain their official catalogue card titles. No agricultural category was crawled. TLS certificate verification enabled. The official20-page medical catalogue was also inspected; all32 named product panels on pages4–19 were transcribed;16 mapped to evident online references and16 extra names stored in supplementary_products. Image-only price list page3 was visually checked. This yields46 named references before cross-range deduplication, with no assertion that differently marketed names are identical.

anomalies.note: Treatment-interne category page says Aucun produit trouvé, but the official downloadable catalogue page17 explicitly lists NEUTROCIDE DD50 CIDEX and OXYCIDE NDD CIDEX; both included as supplementary products.
Six haemodialysis-related products share the same generic manipulated image URL, not a distinct product packshot.

PDF and online cards differ in some spellings/product titles; evident same references mapped through aliases. BIOMA-SURF NDD cidex and GERMA-SURF NDD retained separately because equivalence is not explicit. GERMACIDE4 ANTITACHE and GERMACID E4 ANTITACHE SURFASPRAY also kept separately.
